ui_state.sectionHeader: THE FATAL VULNERABILITY OF SUBJECTIVE PATTERNS

cards.title: 1. The Horizontal Trading Range Trap
cards.desc: Markets spend one-third of the time in sideways trading ranges where trendlines break constantly without directional follow-through.

cards.title: 2. The Retail Whipsaw Drain
cards.desc: Traders buy upside breakouts and short downside breakdowns, only to get stopped out repeatedly as prices revert to the range mean.

cards.title: 3. The Dialectical Solution: Oscillators
cards.desc: John Murphy introduces oscillators (RSI, Stochastics, MACD) to mathematically trade range extremes rather than chasing breakouts.

beats.hindi_tts: मर्फी का क्लासिक फॉर्मूला: हेड की चोटी से नेकलाइन की सीधी दूरी नापकर, नेकलाइन टूटने के बिंदु से नीचे घटाने पर सटीक न्यूनतम टारगेट मिलता है।
beats.en_narration: Murphy's geometric rule: measure the vertical distance from the head to the neckline, and project it down from the breakout point.
beats.subtitle: Measure vertical distance from head to neckline, and project downward from breakout.
beats.en_subtitle: Measure vertical distance from head to neckline, and project downward from breakout.

ui_state.title: Head and Shoulders Minimum Price Target Formula
ui_state.expression: Target Price = Neckline Level - (Head Peak - Neckline Level)

variables.label: Minimum Objective
variables.description: The mathematical minimum price target projected following a decisive neckline break.

variables.label: Neckline Level
variables.description: The support floor connecting the reaction troughs between the left shoulder, head, and right shoulder.

variables.label: Head Peak
variables.description: The highest peak of the reversal formation, representing the final exhausted buying climax.

variables.label: Vertical Base Height
variables.description: The absolute vertical price distance between the head peak and the intervening neckline.

messages.text: Sharma ji, now I finally see the complete picture! No chapter stands alone—Dow Theory gives the macro trend, classical patterns pinpoint entry timing, indicators confirm momentum, candlesticks verify order flow, and intermarket analysis shields us from systemic shocks!

Exactly! Respect the boundary of each tool: let Dow Theory set the primary direction, use classical patterns for entry, confirm with candlesticks and volume, enforce 1:3 risk-reward, and respect intermarket flows. Do this, and the market can never defeat you!

scenes.title: The 8 Inviolable Laws of Technical Analysis

beats.hindi_tts: आइए, उन्नीस चैप्टर्स के सार को इन आठ अटल तकनीकी नियमों में हमेशा के लिए याद कर लें।
beats.en_narration: Let us summarize the core of all 19 chapters into these eight inviolable laws of technical analysis.
beats.subtitle: Summarize all 19 chapters into eight inviolable laws of technical analysis.
beats.en_subtitle: Summarize all 19 chapters into eight inviolable laws of technical analysis.

ui_state.heading: THE 8 LAWS OF TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
steps: 1. Market action discounts everything: all fundamental news and crowd psychology are reflected in price.
2. Trade with the primary trend: the weekly ocean tide overrules all intraday ripples.
3. Demand volume confirmation: valid breakouts require expanding turnover; low volume is a trap.
4. Respect the principle of polarity: broken support becomes resistance, and resistance becomes support.
5. Match the tool to the regime: use moving averages in trends and oscillators in consolidations.
6. Confirm with candlesticks: require multi-bar Japanese price action at key support/resistance zones.
7. Enforce strict money management: risk strictly 1% to 2% per trade with minimum 1:3 reward-to-risk.
8. Consult intermarket macro flows: verify sector breadth and bond yield trends before trading.
